messages:
olivia: starting rollout window now — v3.2.0 pinned for US -> EU -> APAC. canary at 1% for first 10m, then 5% for 20m, then ramp. deploy-bot: rollout started: v3.2.0 -> service-inference (slice:us-west-1) :rocket:
mike: quick capacity check: reserved pool shows 42 GPUs idle in us-west, warm pool 6. should be fine for 1% canary, but watch queue depth.
anya: smoke test plan: run sample prompts from evalset A and B, check latency P95 < 400ms and error rate < 0.2%. I'll post results in ~8m.
samir: heads up — EU quota backend has 18 GPUs free currently, but some dedicated requests are in flight (expected 4 more). if we need to pause, EU is the choke point.
olivia: noted. we'll hold EU until canary green in US. pin v3.2.0 for US explicitly in deploy config (do not auto-failover to v3.1.8).
deploy-bot: canary:us-west-1 1% started at commit abc123. canary health checks: 0/5 failures so far.
anya: canary metrics 6m: latency P50 120ms P95 370ms, errors 0.12%. eval outputs: quality passes for core prompts. +1 to continue.
mike: telemetry: queue depth spiking to 22 for a 60s window during a small client burst. temporary throttle set to 90rps to keep latency in check. ops-oncall: please monitor core alarms (model-errors, gpu-thermal).
ops-oncall: watching. cpu/gpu temps stable. will alert on sustained P95 > 450ms or error rate > 0.5%.
olivia: proceed to 5% in us-west. if 5% stays stable for 20m, we start EU canary at 1% and pin EU to v3.2.0. rollback trigger: any sustained error rate >0.5% for 5m or P95 > 500ms for 2m.
deploy-bot: ramping us-west to 5% now. updated rollout state: 5% -> us-west.
samir: EU warm pool now 15 GPUs free after reallocating some dedicated capacity. approving EU canary start once us-west stable.
anya: 5% us-west check at +12m: latency P95 385ms, errors 0.18%. still under thresholds. quality okay.
mike: small anomaly: rate-limited responses to background batch jobs increased cost by ~3% in the last 6m. not a blocker but flagging.
olivia: okay. starting EU canary at 1% (eu-west-1). pin EU route to v3.2.0. deploy-bot: starting eu-west-1 canary at commit abc123.
deploy-bot: eu-west-1 canary health: 0/5 failures.
ops-oncall: EU telemetry nominal. P95 420ms (higher than US but within our EU SLO buffer). watch for backend DB calls — seeing 2x tail latency on a specific shard.
anya: rerun evalset C for EU region to check locale-sensitive outputs. results in ~7m.
anya: EU evals: minor tokenization edge on a Czech prompt, not regression but noted. recommending proceed but add regression alert to the eval dashboard.
olivia: good. proceed to 5% EU. after 20m stable we'll open APAC canary (ap-southeast-1) at 1% and increase warm pool there if needed.
mike: note on APAC: forecasted demand bump between 02:00-04:00 UTC. we should start warmup earlier by 10m to reduce cold-start risk.
samir: bumped APAC warm pool by 4 GPUs. now at 9 free.
deploy-bot: eu-west-1 ramping to 5%.
ops-oncall: adding temporary circuit-breaker: if cross-region latency > 2s or error rate spikes, auto-pin traffic back to v3.1.8 for affected region. manual override allowed.
mike: recording rollback play: run `deploy-bot rollback --region eu-west-1 --to v3.1.8` if EU error > 0.6% for 3m. ops to confirm within 90s.
olivia: agreed. also set a soft holdpoint at 50% regional traffic for final cutoff. no global ramp beyond 50% until CTO sign-off.
anya: APAC canary started (ap-southeast-1) at 1%. small locale eval running.
deploy-bot: ap-southeast-1 canary health: 0/5 failures.
anya: APAC eval quick check: P95 480ms, errors 0.14%. close to APAC threshold — be cautious on ramp.
mike: given APAC latency, recommend slower ramp: 1% -> 2.5% -> 5% with 15m holds.
olivia: okay, updating rollout policy to stagger APAC more conservatively. deploy-bot: updated policy applied.
samir: one more thing — GPU thermal headroom in ap-southeast-1 drops during sustained 9+ GPU use. ops-oncall please cap concurrency per-GPU to avoid thermal trips.
ops-oncall: set cap per-GPU concurrency to 6 for region. will alert if thermal trends exceed threshold.
mike: tracking release notes item: v3.2.0 includes KV-cache fix, reduced memory spill, prefer-quantized fallback disabled by default. add note about EU Czech tokenization quirk.
olivia: logging decision: proceed with region-by-region rollout, conservative APAC ramp, rollback thresholds as listed. will send out brief release note + postmortem checklist after 24h. thanks team :heart:
deploy-bot: rollout status summary: US 5% stable, EU 5% stable, APAC 2.5% in steady state. monitoring.
ops-oncall: standing by for any alerts.
